name: IINA
title: IINA: free Infuse Pro alternative
job: Plays your movies on a Mac
caption:
Infuse Pro charges $16.99/year to play videos on your Mac. IINA does it for free 🎬

✅ Subtitles built in, including online subtitle search
✅ Picture-in-Picture and trackpad gestures, made for macOS
✅ Video thumbnails and unlimited playback history
✅ No tracking, no telemetry, no subscription

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Mac only (macOS 12+, macOS 11 on Intel). Infuse also runs on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, which IINA doesn't; Infuse's $16.99/year is its Pro plan (basic Infuse is free)

Comment "MOVIE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

beats.say: If you pay seventeen bucks a year just to watch movies on your Mac, stop scrolling.
Wait, people actually pay for that?
Infuse Pro charges seventeen a year. IINA costs nothing.
Drop in a video and it just plays, with clean controls built for your Mac.
It searches for subtitles online, and Picture in Picture keeps your movie floating while you work.
Control it your way, with the keyboard, mouse or trackpad.
It's Infuse Pro, minus the subscription, forever.
Comment Movie, and I'll send you the link.
